features.name: Assassinate
features.desc: You have proficiency with the Poisoner's Kit and the Disguise Kit. In the first round of combat, you have Advantage on attack rolls against creatures that haven't taken a turn yet. When you hit a Surprised creature with Sneak Attack, you deal extra damage equal to your Rogue level.

features.name: Impostor
features.desc: Over 7 days, you create a false identity (documents, acquaintances). As an action, you disguise yourself as another person with Advantage.

features.name: Envenom Weapons
features.desc: The Poison effect of Cunning Strike is enhanced: the target also takes extra Poison damage equal to the number of Sneak Attack dice expended.

features.name: Death Strike
features.desc: When you hit a Surprised creature, you force it to make a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 + Dex modifier + Proficiency Bonus); on a failure, the attack's damage is doubled.
